description: This file implements a notes cache system for a Git repository, managing reading, writing, and validation of cache data using Git internal data structures and functions.

methods.name: int notes_cache_match_validity(struct repository * r,const char * ref,const char * validity)
methods.description: Validates the notes cache by comparing the commit message with the provided validity string.

methods.name: void notes_cache_init(struct repository * r,struct notes_cache * c,const char * name,const char * validity)
methods.description: Initializes the notes cache, setting up references and validity checks.

methods.name: int notes_cache_write(struct notes_cache * c)
methods.description: Writes the notes cache to the repository, creating and updating the necessary Git objects and references.

methods.name: char * notes_cache_get(struct notes_cache * c,struct object_id * key_oid,size_t * outsize)
methods.description: Retrieves the cached note data associated with a specific object ID.

methods.name: int notes_cache_put(struct notes_cache * c,struct object_id * key_oid,const char * data,size_t size)
methods.description: Stores a new note in the cache associated with a specific object ID.
